purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Tirupattur

queries.query: Tirupattur Tamil Nadu official cadastral parcel map GIS land records
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Tirupathur district government's land e-services page, Tamil Nadu e-Services of Land Records, TNGIS, and TNGLMS. The sources document Patta/FMB/Chitta/TSLR procedures and state cadastral/GIS systems, but no anonymous parcel geometry response was obtained.

queries.result: Tamil-language first-party discovery found the Tirupathur district Tamil land-services page. It lists Patta and FMB/Chitta/TSLR, A-Register, Patta verification, and government-land verification, linking to the Tamil Nadu land-record service. No safe parcel polygon or native parcel identity was returned.

officialSources.observation: Official Tirupathur district administration page lists View Patta & FMB/Chitta/TSLR Extract, A-Register, Patta verification, and Poramboke verification, and links to the Tamil Nadu land-record service.
Official Tamil-language district page provides the same land-record procedures and service link.
Official Tamil Nadu Geographical Information System page; inspected content exposed account login and CAPTCHA fields, and no anonymous parcel feature service.

Official Tamil Nadu Government Land Management System describes integration of RoR, cadastral FMB maps, land survey, and related land datasets; it is general state-system evidence, not a Tirupattur polygon response.
